title: Design System: Indonesian Heritage Museum Field Atlas

display.purpose: Museum names, route statements, and archive headlines.

motion.name: atlas-hover
motion.value: transform .25s ease, background .25s ease, color .25s ease
motion.purpose: Small tactile response for actions and cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Terracotta action button for the next museum route.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:46px; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:2px; background:#B65A3B; color:#FFFDF8; font:700 .72rem/1 DM Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:transform .25s ease, background .25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#873F2E; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F0AD86; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Archive Button
components.description: Outlined companion action used beside a stronger route signal.
components.css: .ds-btn-archive { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; padding:0 18px; border:1px solid rgba(255,253,248,.46); border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#FFFDF8; font:700 .72rem/1 DM Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background .25s ease, transform .25s ease; } .ds-btn-archive:hover { background:rgba(255,253,248,.1); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-archive:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F0AD86; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Archive Navigation
components.description: Fixed paper veil navigation with compact wayfinding labels.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; padding:18px 24px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(21,54,65,.2); background:rgba(243,236,222,.92); color:#153641; font:700 .68rem/1.2 DM Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#B65A3B; } .ds-nav button { color:inherit; background:transparent; border:0; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Opaque archive card pairing documentary imagery with a clear route.
components.html:
REGIONAL ROUTE

START WITH ONE ZONE

Follow the collection by place and story.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(21,54,65,.2); border-radius:2px; background:#FFFDF8; color:#153641; box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(19,60,67,.11); } .ds-card-image { height:180px; background:#245F64; } .ds-card-copy { padding:28px 30px 34px; } .ds-card-copy small { color:#B65A3B; font:700 .68rem/1.2 DM Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.2em; } .ds-card-copy h3 { margin:12px 0; font:500 2rem/1 Lora, Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-copy p { margin:0; color:#46606A; font:400 1rem/1.7 DM Sans, sans-serif; }

components.name: Archive Chip
components.description: Small filter or route marker that stays legible against paper or teal.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid rgba(21,54,65,.2); color:#245F64; font:700 .64rem/1 DM Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview: The site behaves like a living field notebook: visitors follow routes, compare regions, and choose a next layer of exploration. Deep teal and indigo-like ink create a calm archive ground; terracotta annotations mark action and discovery; documentary imagery keeps the museum present rather than ornamental. The field-atlas world is deliberately separate from the Glory of Islam Museum's warm gold editorial language.
keyCharacteristics: Dark teal archive heroes with terracotta route markers.
Warm woven-paper texture behind opaque reading surfaces.
Lora display type paired with DM Sans utility copy.
Real museum images and a muted local hero film as evidence.

rules.name: The Material Boundary Rule
rules.body: The paper texture belongs behind the app at z-index 0; never lower the opacity of a content component to reveal it.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Lora speaks for place and story; DM Sans speaks for action and navigation.

dos: Do let real museum imagery carry the meaning of each route.
Do use the local hero film muted, looping, and with a poster fallback.
Do keep the woven paper visible only as a background material.
donts: Don't reuse the Glory of Islam Museum's gold/cream hero language or spotlight glow.
Don't place text directly on a noisy texture without an opaque or darkened surface.
Don't use gradients as decoration; gradients are only image legibility washes.
